definition.title: Tell dates, ages and times
definition.subtitle: Learn, understand, and use a Mandarin pattern.
definition.context: Use the introduced pattern in a bounded sentence. Other wording may be valid Chinese; this task checks this pattern and these words.

blocks.text: Say calendar units from larger to smaller. Dates, ages and clock times can be predicates without 是. Use 点 and 分 for clock time. Combine calendar and clock expressions from larger to smaller: year, month, date, weekday, part of day, clock time. The weekday is a parallel calendar label, not a smaller numerical unit.

examples.text: 五月一号星期一上午九点
examples.pinyin: wǔ yuè yī hào xīngqī yī shàngwǔ jiǔ diǎn
examples.meaning: 9 a.m. on Monday, May 1; the date and weekday are assumed to match in the context
